report.notes: R6-01 root cause (enumerated _DOTCH) replaced by a category-based separator built from the Unicode database: any P*/S* mark run with no space in it except word joiners (Pd, apostrophes, '/', '_'); dot-named marks with spaces on either side; other marks with a space before only unless opening; spelled dot/d0t in any wrapper; split one-letter TLD ('portal.c om'). The caseless-script punctuation exception generalises the old CJK '。' rule. Atomic separator group plus a 10-label host cap prevent backtracking blowup ('a.'*3000 now ~2 s, similar to HEAD). Splitter fix: evaluate.sentences and synthesize._split_answer re-join pieces a link runs across (untrusted.merge_split_links/joins_link); verify/extractive drop adjacent claims that join into a link. New regression file: 34 fail on 806dcd12, 61/61 pass after; tests/web+assist+a2ui 3187 passed. tests/phase2a/test_frozen_core.py::test_base_commit fails because HEAD is not the frozen base e8e3b65 (environment, not this change). Still not caught: 'portal, com'/'portal: com', a dash between labels, unlisted caseless-script IDN TLD after non-'.' punctuation. New over-masking (readability only): 'T&Cs', 'fact... it', 'Wait…what', 'File:line'. Governance ledger is outside the permitted paths, so these limits are recorded only in code comments.
